append_only_source_clarifications.text: Prediction recursion source context length and suffix n indexing must remain distinct; fixed maximal n bounded by original experimental hyperparameter.
Probability of observed key kt computed before sequential addition of prescribed visual event et; historical seating timestamps are not retroactively changed; no motor command execution inferred.

Actual fit approximately maximizes response-time likelihood with five stochastic parser passes, 1000 theta draws x10, OLS rho, central-RT holdout but full observed event parsing; source S1 prior and S2 low-level cutoff impose numerical constraints.
ddUCRP predicts smoothing; stationary trigram near equal global variance; whole-sample >2 effects non-significant at tested endpoints; late higher-order individual correlations conditional.
Exploratory WM effects fail BH; single original HCRP cannot reproduce joint stable old/new skill retention; proposed two-stream arbiter not implemented; error-only prior constrained distinct.

All eight publisher DOI-labelled supplemental originals obtained through DOI-matched NLM PLOS deposit; two independently exact-byte match firstparty publisher; six lack live publisher raw-byte corroboration because documented 502. Do not certify this missing direct bridge or blinded review.
